# UniFi (Ubiquiti) Gotchas

> Known Ubiquiti UniFi Site Manager API patterns that cause wrong conclusions about client coverage.

## Entries

- [UniFi Site Manager cloud key only covers that account -- not all client sites](site-manager-cloud-key-coverage.md): The api.ui.com key only exposes its own account's consoles/sites; locally-managed controllers are invisible. If a client's site is absent, verify on-site rather than reporting zero devices. HIGH.
